packages.description: Install Python and npm packages from PyPI and the npm registry.

github-read.description: Clone and read GitHub repositories, with a read-only GitHub token (speaker inserts it; set up the secret GITHUB_READ for api.github.com and github.com).

developer.description: Everyday coding: package registries, GitHub downloads and releases, and Context7 library docs (a speaker service).

research.description: Public web research: keyless Exa search through the pi-web-access extension, plus Wikipedia and arXiv pages.

loop.description: Scheduled and self-paced wake-ups (/loop, cron jobs) and background process monitors, with no network access.

notes-read.description: Read the owner's Obsidian notes and Karakeep bookmarks through speaker's proxy.

life.description: The owner's planning: edit Home Assistant to-do lists (synced to Apple Reminders), read the Obsidian notes, and write in their Tasks and Planning folders.
